stage: Physical door and ordinary editable paths complete
delivered: One shared metre-scale door leaf drives exterior renderer, interior renderer and authoritative physics. Closed blocks walking; open permits walking. Open/close takes effect after acknowledgement without an asynchronous swing that disagrees with collision.

Opening, closing and moving/remodelling a home reject an occupied sweep or destination doorway, including saved visitors without a live presence heartbeat. People are never pushed or teleported by the action.

Door-only revisions fence old movement batches while preserving valid standing/airborne position, velocity and held movement/camera orientation. Door changes do not rebuild terrain or static building resources.

Generator v3 saves ordinary unscaled Path objects within the same placement, terrain seating, save/history and collision contracts as player-built Path. New layouts cap at 40 objects and four buildings, leaving 24 objects/four buildings available.
Public sample v2 uses ordinary Path and player kit blueprints, capped at 64 total objects. Runtime no longer draws route-specific continuous paving or clears flora from navigation metadata.

Existing v1/v2 manifests are kept as immutable creation receipts. Owners can preview normal paths with exact counts, cancel without writes, then explicitly apply an atomic batch. Old objects, furniture, names, groups and manifest bytes remain intact.
Overview fog adapts to camera pullback, fixing the washed-out 390px public planet while preserving walking fog.
